intro.heading: Experience Relief with Wisdom Teeth Removal in Santa Clarita
paragraphs: Wisdom teeth don’t always grow in the way they should—and when they don’t, they can cause pain, swelling, infection, and damage to surrounding teeth. At Valencia Dentistry, we offer precise, comfortable wisdom teeth removal in Santa Clarita tailored to your needs. Whether your wisdom teeth are impacted, crowding other teeth, or causing ongoing discomfort, Dr. Lavi and our team are here to help with advanced technology, sedation options, and a warm, supportive approach. From your first consultation to your last follow-up, we’ll guide you every step of the way toward relief and recovery.

understanding.heading: Different Types of Wisdom Teeth Removal
understanding.intro: Not all wisdom teeth are the same—and neither are the procedures used to remove them. At Valencia Dentistry, we tailor each extraction based on how the tooth is positioned and how it’s affecting your oral health. Here are the two most common types of wisdom teeth removal: Timing matters when it comes to wisdom teeth. Removing them before they fully develop—or before complications arise—can make the process smoother and protect your long-term oral health. Easier Recovery Younger patients tend to heal faster with fewer post-op issues. Fewer Complications Prevents infections, cysts, and damage to neighboring teeth. Less Crowding Avoids misalignment that can undo years of orthodontic work. Improved Oral Hygiene Makes it easier to brush and floss back molars. Peace of Mind Eliminates the risk of painful flare-ups down the road.

items.title: Simple Extraction
items.text: Used when the wisdom tooth has fully erupted through the gum line. This type of removal is typically quick and straightforward, often completed under local anesthesia.

items.title: Surgical Extraction
items.text: Necessary when the tooth is impacted (trapped beneath the gum or bone) or partially erupted. This procedure may involve making a small incision in the gum or breaking the tooth into smaller pieces for easier removal. Sedation options are available to ensure a stress-free experience.

process.heading: The Wisdom Teeth Removal Process
process.intro: At Valencia Dentistry, we take the stress out of oral surgery with a step-by-step approach that’s clear, comfortable, and fully personalized. From your initial consultation to post-op recovery, our team is here to guide you through every phase with compassion and transparency.

steps.title: Consultation & Digital Imaging
steps.text: We start with a detailed exam and 3D imaging to evaluate your wisdom teeth. Dr. Lavi will review your X-rays, discuss your symptoms, and walk you through the best treatment approach for your unique situation.

steps.title: Comfortable In-Office Procedure
steps.text: Your wisdom teeth will be removed using gentle techniques and advanced tools. Local anesthesia is used in all cases, with sedation options available to keep you completely relaxed during the procedure. Most extractions are completed in under an hour.

steps.title: Smooth Recovery & Follow-Up
steps.text: After your procedure, we’ll provide step-by-step instructions for home care and schedule a follow-up visit to ensure proper healing. Most patients return to their normal routines within a few days.

candidate.heading: Who Needs Wisdom Teeth Removal?
candidate.text: Not everyone needs their wisdom teeth removed—but for many, it’s a preventive step that protects long-term oral health. Dr. Lavi recommends evaluating wisdom teeth in your late teens or early twenties, when removal is typically easier and healing is faster. You may be a good candidate for wisdom teeth removal in Santa Clarita if you:
bullets: Experience pain, swelling, or pressure in the back of your mouth
Have impacted or partially erupted wisdom teeth
Notice shifting or crowding in nearby teeth
Struggle to keep back molars clean and free from infection
Show signs of cysts or bone damage on dental X-rays

care.heading: Pre- and Post-Op Care Instructions for Wisdom Teeth Removal
care.intro: A smooth recovery starts with the right preparation. At Valencia Dentistry, we give you everything you need to feel confident before and after your procedure. Here’s what to expect:
before: Follow Fasting Guidelines – If you’re receiving sedation, don’t eat or drink for 6–8 hours beforehand.
Arrange a Ride - You’ll need someone to drive you home if sedation is used.
Pause Medications if Directed– Dr. Lavi will advise you on any adjustments.
Avoid Smoking & Alcohol– Refrain for at least 24 hours before surgery.
Brush Gently– Maintain good hygiene without irritating the area.
after: Rest the First Day– Limit activity and keep your head elevated.
Eat Soft Foods– Think yogurt, mashed potatoes, smoothies, and soup.
Skip the Straw– Avoid straws, smoking, or spitting to prevent dry socket.
Use Cold Compresses– Reduce swelling with ice packs in 20-minute intervals.
Keep It Clean– Rinse with warm salt water and gently brush around the area.

faqs.q: When is the best time to remove wisdom teeth?
faqs.a: The ideal time for removal is between ages 17–25, before the roots fully develop. Early removal helps prevent crowding, pain, and future complications.

faqs.q: Will I be awake during the procedure?
faqs.a: That depends on your preference. We offer local anesthesia, nitrous oxide, and oral sedation to ensure your comfort. Dr. Lavi will help you choose what’s best for you.
Most patients feel significantly better within 3–4 days. Full healing takes about 1–2 weeks, depending on the number of teeth removed and the complexity of the procedure.

faqs.q: What can I eat after wisdom teeth removal?
faqs.a: Stick to soft foods like smoothies, yogurt, mashed potatoes, and soup. Avoid anything spicy, crunchy, or too hot for several days.
